caption: The drawing depicts a single jug or pitcher positioned centrally against a plain, light-colored background. The vessel is rendered in shades of reddish-brown with some highlights and shadowing to suggest gloss and curvature. The jug has an ornate handle on the left side, and its body is faceted with decorative vertical lines and patterns. The upper portion of the jug features a relief of a human head in profile, with visible facial details, curly hair, and a tricorn hat that forms the rim of the jug. The overall shape of the jug is bulbous at the base, narrowing at the neck, and flaring slightly at the opening, with the hat brim creating an uneven upper edge. The background is plain, contained within a rectangular border, and does not contain any additional objects or details.
title: Toby Mug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
